This game is the closest you will ever get to being a one ton machine of the God Emporer's will. With each orc you crush underfoot, and which each heretic you purge from the galaxay, you come more and more into the savage third person epic that this game encompasses. Cards on the table, I like the lore of 40k. And that def. had a hand in making me love this game as I do. But what it boils down to is that through gameplay mechanics subtle and outragous, you don the MK 8 Errant power armour and become Titus. 

Viscera and glory await you, son of Terra. Rev your chainsword and charge for the glory of the imperium. (buy this game)
Even though I have beaten it on HARD difficulty level on first run it is still worth a replay!

I bought it for a good price a few weeks ago. Now it no longer works due to a bug. I have seen half of it so far. The close combats with the overwhelming amounts of enemies are creating a fierce battle scenario which is probably somewhat unique.
Suitable for anyone who enjoys to be forced to fight. Come on join us now and fight for the emperor.
